Synopsis:
A Reuters economist poll finds the Bank of England will hold Bank Rate at 3.75% through at least mid-2027. Energy price pressures from the ongoing U.S.-Israeli war on Iran are delaying rate cuts, with inflation peaking around 3.3% in November before declining. Financial markets price in three rate hikes by mid-2027, though most economists disagree, expecting a first cut only in Q3 2027. Growth remains modest at ~1.1–1.2% through 2027. Rising global bond yields are tightening financial conditions independently, giving the MPC room to remain patient.
